document.title: vitadeck-150 may put the Docker smoke and stb_ds fixes in one part
document.summary: The vitadeck-150 eval case accepts one build-fixes part and lowers the part minimum to 4.

groups.title: Allow one build-fixes part
groups.summary: The Docker smoke and stb_ds pair moves from `partsApart` to `apart`, so the two fixes can share a part but not a group.

attention.note: `parts.min` drops from 5 to 4. A review that puts both build fixes in one part and folds the agent docs into another part now passes. The other nine `partsApart` pairs still keep the drive script, the demo section count, and the Pages fix in parts of their own.

fileNotes.eval/cases/vitadeck-150/case.json: Moves the smoke-docker and stb_ds pair to `apart`; `parts.min` is 4.
fileNotes.eval/cases/vitadeck-150/expected.md: The Notes say why the build fixes may share a part.
